quest.title: Gift of the Mirage
quest.description: On Hiisi Island, the angler Pekkani finds himself puzzled by an unseen force disturbing his catch...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Shhh! Keep it down... Ah, forget it. Not like I was gonna catch anything anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Come on, kid, isn't it obvious? I'm timing my cast. What, did you think I was waving this rod around to cast spells or something?

choices.text: Well... you are a member of the Frostmoon Scions, so maybe it's not that far off base...

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: #Haha, you're giving me too much credit, {M#young man}{F#young lady}. I'm barely half a Frostmoon Scion. Not even an acolyte. Just a regular guy with no kuuvahki power to speak of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, this is the first time Paimon's seen someone time their fishing down to the second...

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: Well, what matters is your fishing technique, not how long you stand on the shore. Old Ilmari never got that — no wonder he never caught anything.

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: Hmm? So I take it you two must be treasure hunters?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, we're adventurers... But we do take on work. Do you need something?

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: Pretty much. As long as you're up for getting paid to do a job, who you are is all the same to me. I've got something you could help with — if you've got time.

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: You see, I'm the best angler on Hiisi Island by a long shot. No one, not even successive generations of Moonchanters, could surpass me in fishing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? That's amazing... Wait, that doesn't mean anything! Fishing isn't even part of a Moonchanter's job!

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: Still, even with all this skill, I haven't caught a single fish lately. Makes no sense, right?

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: So obviously, the problem isn't with me, but with the environment. Just as it is with the cursed Eye of Kratti, there must be something underwater affecting the fish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like quite the leap in logic...

response.speaker: Pekkani
response.text: Anyway, I was hoping you two could check the nearby waters, see what's scaring the fish off. Don't worry, you'll be properly compensated for your efforts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since there's a reward involved, we'll take a look around... but no promises we'll actually find anything weird, okay?

choices.text: Maybe you're catching a bestest travel companion... Who knows?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't make it sound like anyone can fish up their bestest travel companion with a casual cast! Wait... That's not even the point here!

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Please, check the area and see what's scaring the fish off.

talks.objective: Place the fragment(s) on the stone

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Hey, did you see that? I don't even know what happened — one moment, I was looking away, and the next thing I knew, that big rock just flew off!

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Oh my! I have no idea what any of that means, but if you can pull off something that amazing, you must have the Moon Ma{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}iden's favor!

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Oh, the Moon Goddess protects! She protects indeed! Now I can fish here to my heart's content — so long as that annoying bard doesn't bring his pet over or, Goddess forbid, start singing...

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: As promised, here's your payment. Although I haven't caught any fish lately, I've reeled in all kinds of other stuff, some of which should be worth quite a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Pekkani
dialogues.text: Not that Mora's much use around Hiisi Island anyway, so it's all yours. Thanks for your help — now, it's time to fish in peace!
